items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: when Ben was with Duke, it was one of the best sounding bands Duke had. But this particular band -- Ben would always be there.

ctx.x: Ben Witted, that was the alto player I told you that Ben Waters and I stayed with. Great alto. Great musician.
Where was he from and what was some of his outstanding qualities? I've heard of him before.
